report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy (error_rate 0.0012, p95 73ms, no dependency timeouts, no pool waiters) and logs show 200/ok, contradicting the operator's deployment-caused checkout failure hypothesis. The deploy record only proves version facts (3.3.1 from 3.3.0) and cannot establish causality; its age (~43h) also undercuts 'recent'. No checkout/order evidence is present, so no bounded candidate is substantiated. Handing off for checkout-side evidence.
